title: pi guard configuration
description: Configuration for the pi guard extension (CARE pre-execution verification + safety tiers + bwrap sandbox + permission prompts). Lives at ~/.pi/agent/guard.jsonc — a JSONC file, so comments and trailing commas are allowed.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema file (editor hint).

defaultTier.description: Safety tier at startup. off = no sandbox, everything prompts (CARE still blocks DENY); on = sandbox, no network, CARE-graded auto-allow; net = sandbox with network; readonly = everything read-only, writes blocked.

mode.description: CARE decision thresholds. strict = tighter (more commands land in WARN/DENY), auto = wider WARN band.

warnPolicy.description: How the WARN band is handled. prompt = ask the human judge (default); deny = treat WARN like DENY (hard block).

allowedReadDirs.description: Directories (supports a leading ~) whose files are auto-allowed for the read tool, in addition to the project directory.

writableDirs.description: Directories (supports a leading ~) bound writable inside the bwrap sandbox. Everything else stays read-only; the project directory is always writable in the on/net tiers. Ignored in the readonly tier.

overrides.description: Per-head / per-path escape hatches. allow* entries are the only way to override a DENY.

allowHeads.description: Command heads to force-allow (lifts WARN/DENY). Prefer head+subcommand specificity.

denyHeads.description: Command heads to force-deny regardless of CARE's verdict.

allowPaths.description: Substrings that, when present in the command, force-allow it.

denyPaths.description: Substrings that, when present in the command, force-deny it.
